scenarios.title: combat.missileDodge 1: a dangerous missile near the hero writes the evidence line (sidestep, held or no-room)
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 30, gold 3000, potions and scrolls, field start by debug goto 2, monsters by debug spawn (CHEATED position and encounter: mechanics only, never evidence about balance or play).
scenarios.notes: Three Gloams (willowisp1, lightning) beside a clvl 30 hero. The rule only counts missiles whose missiles.txt name holds firewall, hydra, chaos or lightning (d2.MissileKindByName, U names). U: that debug spawn takes willowisp1 and that its bolt's name holds `lightning`; a run with zero evidence lines and zero `sidestepping missile` lines DISPROVES the kind match for this monster and is the finding. Pass also proves the knob for graduation only together with `outcome=sidestep` and no death; count the outcomes beside the verdict. Card evid1.

assert.why: the rule met a dangerous missile (V marker: dodge.go sidestepMissiles, `combat evidence rule=missileDodge outcome=...`)

scenarios.title: combat.threatDodge 1: a ranked hostile missile writes the evidence line (dodge, no-room or kill-shooter)
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 30, gold 3000, potions and scrolls, field start by debug goto 2, monsters by debug spawn (CHEATED position and encounter: mechanics only, never evidence about balance or play).
scenarios.notes: Three Fallen Shamans (slow fireballs) and three Fallen beside the hero. The line is written only when a hostile missile is inside `combat.dodgeRadius` (4) while the fight may evade, so a shaman has to shoot at the hero (U how often in the budget; the melee class closes in and gives it less time than the caster). Outcomes: dodge = stepped away, no-room = no free cell, kill-shooter = the table says too fast to dodge. Card evid1.

assert.why: the threat table ranked a hostile missile inside combat.dodgeRadius (V marker: evidence.go noteThreat)

scenarios.title: combat.standOK 1: a Fallen that stands out of shot past combat.reachSec is kept, not dropped
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 30, gold 3000, potions and scrolls, field start by debug goto 2, monsters by debug spawn (CHEATED position and encounter: mechanics only, never evidence about balance or play).
scenarios.notes: Six Fallen and `combat.reachSec` at its floor (6 s) so the reach rule comes due early. The line needs a target engaged 6 s with no shot (a Fallen that stands away or runs after a kill, S mon-wake-trace); U whether that happens in every run: zero evidence lines with zero `never in range` lines means the case did not arise (not exercised), not a fail of the rule. Pair: evid.stand-ok.control. Card evid1.

assert.why: a stander was kept past reachSec (V marker: fight.go engage, `combat evidence rule=standOK outcome=kept`)

assert.pattern: never in range with a clear line
assert.why: with the knob on no Fallen is dropped as never in range (only Fallen are spawned)

scenarios.title: bot.portalGuard 1: a town portal asked for in a fight is passed or refused by the damage rule, with its line
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 6, gold 3000, potions and scrolls, field start by debug goto 2, life by the setup's life_pct, monsters by debug spawn (CHEATED position and encounter: mechanics only, never evidence about balance or play).
scenarios.notes: A clvl 6 hero at 45 percent life with no potions, five scrolls and twelve Fallen around it: the survival rule asks for a town portal (hurt and short of potions), the guard decides. Expected damage of one Fallen is small, so `allowed` is the likely line at 1 or 2 adjacent and `refused: expected damage` at more. U: which of the two a run shows and whether the hero is `in fight` when the rule asks (a quiet portal writes nothing). This is a reduced drill R3 (docs/fixportalmelee.md): it shows the rule decides, it does not measure the cast time. Card evid1.

assert.why: mode 1 decided a fight portal: refused (fighter.go noteCastRefused) or allowed (evidence.go noteCastGuard)

scenarios.title: bot.checkpointEnable 1: a healthy hero alone at the entry of a checkpoint area drops the checkpoint portal
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 30, gold 3000, potions and scrolls, field start by debug goto 28 (CHEATED position and encounter: mechanics only, never evidence about balance or play).
scenarios.notes: Field start in the Barracks (area 28, in plandata.CheckpointArea) with five scrolls (reserve `bot.checkpointMinScrolls` 2). The rule casts when no hostile is within `bot.checkpointSafeRadius`; when the start cell has monsters near, the run shows `checkpoint idle why=hostiles near` instead (the new evidence line) and the cast comes after the first fight only while the hero is still within `bot.checkpointEntryDist` of the entry (U). Retreat and the return after a death are card ckptlive (TASK-990), not asserted here. no_writes is left out: the checkpoint is a scroll read through the input channel but the lab d2d has verbs on. Card evid1.

assert.why: the cast was recorded (V marker: checkpoint.go toLocked, `checkpoint from=none to=set`)
